$comment: About → Constellation. One interest per star of Ursa Minor. star must be one of: polaris, yildun, epsilon, zeta, eta, pherkad, kochab. Polaris is the anchor (core interest). photo is optional.

interests.title: Tetris
interests.text: The thrill of split-second decisions, sending spikes, downstacking, and building convoluted spins.

interests.title: Piano
interests.text: Originally classically trained, I now enjoy playing a variety of music, from pop to classical. Current projects: Another Love, Mariage d'Amour, 我的歌聲裡.

interests.title: Volleyball
interests.text: My favorite sport by far. Teammates know that I am a better libero than middle but still pack a nasty pin block.

interests.title: Sidequesting
interests.text: Anything to not do work honestly. If you invite me to sidequest, chances are I'll say yes. I love to try new things and have new experiences.

interests.title: Traveling
interests.text: If you ask me if I've been to a place, chances are I haven't. I love making itineraries for trips and exploring new places.

interests.title: Reading
interests.text: Once an avid reader, I have fallen out of the habit, but actively making an effort. Love fantasy such as The Unwanteds and Eragon.

interests.title: Foodie
interests.text: Still a Beli warrior in training, but I take my boba very seriously and love finding good food spots. Can't cook for my life though.
